name: Himalay Cherukuri
headline: Data Analyst | Data Science & Forecasting: Python, SQL and Power BI analytics that drive operational decisions
tagline: 8+ years turning data into forecasts, dashboards and decisions, across hospitality operations, supply chain, payments and banking.
about: I'm a Data Analyst with 8+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, financial reporting, ETL pipeline development and business analysis. Most recently I consolidated 20 years of operating history across 17 properties and built Python forecasts that held within ~8–10% of actuals. Before that I spent 6+ years at Bank of America across retail banking, trade finance and AML/KYC compliance, delivering dashboards and automated reporting. I've also built ETL pipelines on AWS and Azure with Python, SQL, Spark and Airflow. I hold an M.S. in Business Analytics and am pursuing a Ph.D. in Information Technology.
